title: Public landing page and routing updates for Foam Daddy Storefront

requirements.summary: Create a dedicated public landing page at "/" with CTAs to Products and Request Quote.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting "/" shows a dedicated landing page (not the full product listing page).
Landing page includes prominent buttons/links to the products page and the request-quote page.
Landing page renders correctly without requiring authentication.

file_operations.description: Add a lightweight public LandingPage that introduces Foam Daddy and includes clear calls-to-action linking to the products route and the request-quote route; use existing generated brand/hero assets where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the new LandingPage into the router as the component for path "/" so it becomes the publicly accessible entry route. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Move StorefrontPage to a new public "/products" route and update navigation links to match.
acceptanceCriteria: The full storefront/product browsing experience is available at the new route (e.g., "/products").
Header and footer “Products” links navigate to the new products route (not "/").
The site logo/brand link in the header navigates to the landing page at "/".
No existing non-admin routes require login; only "/admin/*" remains protected.

file_operations.description: Move StorefrontPage routing off of "/" to a dedicated public route ("/products"), keeping existing product detail/cart/checkout/request-quote routes intact and leaving all "/admin/*" routing behavior unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the primary navigation so the “Products” link points to "/products" (logo/brand link remains "/"), ensuring public routes remain accessible without authentication and admin navigation continues to point to "/admin/*". Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update footer “Products” quick link to point to "/products" (instead of "/"), keeping other links unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the post-checkout “Continue Shopping” navigation to point to the new products route ("/products") so users land back in the storefront browsing experience. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update public HTML title and meta description for a landing-page-first experience.
acceptanceCriteria: The document <title> and meta description in frontend/index.html reflect the new landing-page-first experience and remain accurate for the overall site.
Metadata changes do not break the SPA boot process (app still mounts and routes normally).

file_operations.description: Adjust the document title and meta description to reflect the new landing page as the primary entry point, while still describing products and quote requests in English; do not change the SPA mount element or script tag. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
